spans.s: --the son of कावष, and Purohita of Janamejaya. भा. IX. २२. ३७.
--a white horse came out of the churning of the ocean; claimed by the Sun god. M. २५०. 3; २५१. 3. [page२-030+ ३०]
--a horse of the Moon's chariot. वा. ५२. ५३.
--a people of the नर्मदा region. वा. ४५. १२९.
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९१. २९.
(I)--a name of ब्रह्मा (s.v.). भा. XI. १५. १६.
(II)--(Turiya Indrayuk?-ब्र्। प्।); a Deva (a- jita). Br. II. १३. ९४; वा. ३१. 8.
--frank incense of white colour for धूप of the पितृस्. Br. III. ११. ६९.
--(तुष्करस्-ब्र्। प्।; तुरुष्कार-वा। प्।)-- Fourteen kings among them, see Maunas. भा.
XII. 1

(I)--a son of ययाति and देवयानी; refused to part with his youth to his father; he was therefore cursed to have no issue and to live a king among the wicked and low tribes and Mlecchas; became overlord of the Mlecchas in the western part of the kingdom. His son was

Vahni.
1

: भा. IX. १८. ३३ and ४१; १९. २२; २३. १६; M. २४. ५३; वा. ९३. १६.
His line became merged with the Paurava line, during the time of

Marutta.
2

: Br. III. ६८. १६, ४०, ५०; ७३. १२६; ७४. 1 and 4; M. ३३. 9-११; वा. ९९. 1-4.
Equal to विष्णु; father of Garbha; Yavanas take their origin from him,
3: M. ३२. 9; ३४. ३०; ४८. 1.
got the south-east of the kingdom, when his father retired to the forest.
4: वा. ९३. ३९-44, ८९.
[page२-031+ २९]
(II)--a son of देवयानी and Yadu? Br.
